dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Waiting for the monsters to die of old age, Kinich? Or did they pound that thick skull of yours into the ground enough that even you decided to just find a cozy little corner to play dead in?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I seem to recall that your face was the one being used as a mop.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Wha... M—Mere hallucinations, born of your exhaustion! Why, I remain full of spit and vinegar!
